purpose: Prototype/testing for PCA compression, trajectory-aware clustering, visualization, and anomaly scoring
source: Synthetic data generated for this project; not real flight telemetry

origin_coordinates.note: Illustrative coordinate origin; trajectories are simulated

labels.coordinated_survey: D01-D06: similar sweep/survey behaviour with lane offsets
labels.speed_altitude_deviation: D09: simulated speed and altitude deviation injected at t=65..105
labels.route_deviation: D10: simulated path deviation injected at t=80..125

important_caveat: Labels are scenario ground truth for software testing, not expert-validated real-world anomaly labels. Do not report performance on this synthetic dataset as real-world accuracy.
